ads.title: What every doula tells new moms
ads.body:
I'm a postpartum doula. The first thing I do isn't for the baby.

Day one home, mom's a mess hasn't slept, in her husband's stained tee, doesn't feel
like herself.
So I don't reach for the baby. I reach for her.
I tell her to go change, and I hand her this Kimonoji Samue set.
Because new moms need taking care of too.
Wraps open for the 4am feeds… no shirt to fight with.
So soft she forgets it's on. Put-together enough for the door.
Now it's the only thing she wears.
Best thing I do for my moms — and it's not even for the baby
